26a98973af0ebdd0.description: نبحث عن محاسب زبائن (كاشير) للانضمام إلى فريقنا، لتقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء. تتضمن مهام الوظيفة استلام المدفوعات، التعامل مع استفسارات العملاء، والمحافظة على دقة سجلات المبيعات. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على العمل بكفاءة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم.

261edf76f984421d.description: Summary: Müller’s Solutions is looking for a certified SAP Authorization Consultant to join an SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation. You will design and manage user access and security, making sure business roles, restrictions and identity setup are secure, compliant and in line with client job functions. You will work closely with functional consultants and client stakeholders from design through go-live. This is a remote role. Description: Design business roles from SAP templates, based on client job functions and processes Configure business catalogs, business role templates and read/write/value help restrictions Set up SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS) for SSO, user provisioning and integration with the client’s identity provider Run segregation of duties (SoD) checks and fix access conflicts Manage user creation, role assignment and access changes through go-live and hypercare Support internal and external audits with access reviews and documentation Document role designs and the security setup, and handle authorization issues and support requests Requirements: 4+ years of SAP security/authorization experience, with hands-on S/4HANA Public Cloud IAM exposure Valid SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification (security certification preferred) Solid knowledge of SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS) and SSO setup (SAML, Azure AD / Entra ID) Good understanding of SoD, compliance and audit requirements Experience on at least one S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation Strong communication skills in English and able to work directly with clients remotely Experience with SAP GRC or SAP Cloud IAG is a plus

26a5db8cfb565632.description: About the Role Hill International (KSA) is seeking a full-time Administrative Assistant to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah Region. This role involves providing comprehensive on-site office support, coordinating daily operations, and efficiently managing administrative tasks to ensure smooth project functioning. Key Responsibilities Liaise with senior management to prioritize tasks and provide administrative support tailored to project demands. Organize office maintenance and repair work, including supervising the implementation of new office systems, while interfacing with client teams and adhering to Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures. Develop and implement new office procedures and policies. Ensure adherence to approved procedures by all staff members. Collaborate with other staff to develop and improve services. Maintain compliance with Hill International's Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures. Perform additional duties as assigned by the line manager or supervisor. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent is required; an associate's or bachelor's degree is preferred. Proven experience in administrative, clerical, or general office support roles. Skills and Competencies Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and other office management software. Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills, with a keen attention to detail. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, enabling professional interaction with employees, clients, and visitors. Work Environment The Administrative Assistant will operate within an organized office environment, providing essential support to staff, clients, and management. The role requires strong communication and multitasking abilities to manage a diverse range of administrative tasks efficiently. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

262285ded0b74a30.description: About Hikma Pharmaceuticals Hikma Pharmaceuticals has been providing high-quality medicines for over 45 years, making them accessible to those who need them. The company operates with a global team of over 9,500 employees and maintains 29 manufacturing plants and 9 R&D centers across MENA, North America, and Europe. Hikma is a partner for over 800 generic, specialty, and branded pharmaceutical products. The Role of Medical Representative Hikma Pharmaceuticals is seeking a Medical Representative to join its team in Makkah, covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves promoting Hikma products and building relationships with healthcare professionals within the assigned territory. Key Responsibilities Review updated records of sales targets and activities, and assess performance against goals. Develop relationships and organize appointments and events with Hikma customers, including doctors, pharmacists, and hospital medical teams, to promote products and meet sales targets. Increase awareness of Hikma products through continuous learning and information sharing with healthcare providers. Obtain current information about doctors, pharmacists, and hospitals, and prospect new customers to maintain efficient customer lists. Ensure proper product availability, territory coverage, reporting, feedback, and monitor competitor activity and products. Follow up on and review Hikma products’ market performance through client responses and other indicators, anticipating new market opportunities. Prepare timely planning, feedback, and sales documentation/sales reporting for supervisors/managers as requested to ensure optimal territory coverage. Ensure compliant behavior in correspondence with company rules and regulations. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will embody Hikma’s values: innovative, driven to keep learning; caring, genuinely compassionate in their work; and collaborative, eager to solve problems together. This role is suited for individuals who are committed to making an impact within a supportive work environment. Experience and Work Type This position requires 0-1 years of relevant experience. It is a full-time role based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering the cities of Jeddah and Makkah. Work Environment At Hikma, employees are supported by a culture that prioritizes development, wellbeing, and an inclusive approach that values contributions from all team members.

2669e7651f2ce178.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company-Luberef is seeking an Asset Optimizer Engineer to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience. The primary objective of this role is to develop and manage production schedules to meet planned targets and to conduct comparative analyses that enhance production and optimization efforts. Key Responsibilities Update daily production schedules based on inventory changes and make necessary adjustments to meet plan targets. Coordinate with the process section and Operations to ensure required unit flow rates and yields are met. Monitor and update the monthly approved plan, reflecting the impact of any shutdowns and preparing various synergies to optimize production. Issue Daily Operating Instructions (DOI) in coordination with process and operations teams. Conduct monthly analyses of refinery operations, comparing actual production against the agreed plan and predicted outcomes for the same actual feedstock. Assist the Production Planning Supervisor in preparing comments on refinery performance. Identify potential problems and develop possible solutions during daily review meetings with the L-II Production Planning Supervisor. Prepare forecasts for feedstock requirements and by-products. Ensure all custody measurements and calibrations are maintained as per HMP. Issue required Management of Change (MOC) requests to improve work processes and follow up with concerned departments on implementation. Submit regular reports on refinery performance, highlighting any pending issues or problems that require resolution. Perform any other job-related duties as requested by the immediate supervisor or manager. Required Experience Candidates for the Asset Optimizer Engineer position should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. This role is suitable for individuals who are at the beginning of their professional journey and are eager to contribute to production planning and optimization within a refinery environment. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves close coordination with various operational and process sections within the refinery to ensure efficient production and adherence to planned targets. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

26857e863427dcd0.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Quality Inspector to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on ensuring the quality of installed accessories in vehicles within the PIO operation. The Quality Inspector will verify that accessories meet specified standards for function and appearance, ensuring they are suitable for customer use according to designed procedures. Key Responsibilities Perform quality inspections at designated checkpoints, including final inspection, as per defined procedures. Conduct random inspections to ensure consistent quality. Complete inspection check sheets in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs). Execute NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness) testing. Ensure timely data entry in JSAP for production fulfillment and customer deliveries. Register billing in JSAP for each accessory label. Report back jobs to the supervisor for vehicles with issues that cannot be repaired online. Operational Activities Coordinate inspection activities, clarify inspection results, and align on corrective actions without disrupting the production flow. Report inspection findings, non-conformities, and daily QC results, communicating inspection status and adhering to standard QC procedures. Escalate critical quality issues, major non-conformities, or recurring defects that require management attention. Submit inspection records, Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and checklists to maintain accurate quality documentation and traceability. Share inspection techniques, clarify standards, coordinate workload, and manage the handover of inspection activities. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in quality inspection. Demonstrated ability to organize, plan, and monitor operations related to dispatch. Proficiency in performing quality inspections as per defined procedures. Experience with data entry systems like JSAP. Work Environment and Coordination The role involves close coordination with other Vehicle Logistics Department (VLD) functions, including the planning and inventory management department, to ensure efficient and effective execution of plans. The Quality Inspector will operate in a dynamic environment focused on maintaining high-quality standards for vehicle accessories.

26eab8bd8b4d152a.description: About the Role * Naghi Motors is seeking a Fleet Sales Executive to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on generating and managing fleet sales by acquiring new customers and maintaining strong relationships with existing corporate, government, rental, and leasing clients. The executive will be responsible for achieving assigned sales targets and delivering excellent customer service. Key Responsibilities Identify, prospect, and develop new fleet sales opportunities within corporate, government, rental, and institutional segments. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned fleet sales targets and market share objectives. Conduct client meetings, presentations, and needs assessments to understand customer fleet requirements. Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of fleet customers, ensuring long-term relationships and repeat business. Act as the primary point of contact for fleet customers throughout the sales lifecycle. Proactively identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, including vehicles, financing, maintenance, and value-added services. Solution Development and Negotiation Prepare and present fleet proposals, quotations, and pricing structures aligned with customer needs and company policies. Advise customers on vehicle selection, fleet optimization, total cost of ownership (TCO), and lifecycle management. Negotiate commercial terms and contracts within approved authority levels. Order and Delivery Management Coordinate vehicle orders, specifications, production schedules, and delivery timelines with internal sales support, logistics, and aftersales teams. Monitor order progress and ensure timely vehicle delivery, registration, and handover. Ensure accurate completion of sales contracts, documentation, and compliance requirements. Reporting and Compliance Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and order data in CRM and sales systems. Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and pipeline updates for management review. Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback within the fleet segment. Ensure compliance with company sales policies, pricing guidelines, and ethical standards. Adhere to legal, financial, and regulatory requirements related to fleet sales and contracts. Support internal audits, reporting requirements, and continuous process improvement initiatives. Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably within the automotive or fleet sales sector. The role requires a strong understanding of sales processes, account management, and customer relationship building. The ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and contribute to strategic sales objectives is essential.

26b21e03236dbb57.description: About the Role Jersey Integrated is seeking a Senior Electrical Design Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position responsible for leading electrical design efforts for building and infrastructure projects. The role involves developing detailed layouts, schematics, and specifications for power distribution and related systems. Key Responsibilities Reviewing project requirements and specifications. Performing electrical load calculations to ensure system efficiency and safety. Coordinating effectively with multidisciplinary design teams. Ensuring all designs comply with relevant codes and industry standards. Preparing and reviewing technical drawings and comprehensive documentation. Supporting tender and construction phases of projects. Providing guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and designers. Collaboration and Project Alignment The Senior Electrical Design Engineer will collaborate with project managers, clients, and external stakeholders. This collaboration is essential to ensure that all designs are safe, efficient, and cost-effective, while also being aligned with overall MEP integration needs for each project. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical design, specifically within building and infrastructure projects. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active participation within a project team environment.

26a40e66d61f4c55.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة الحديقة والمزرعة عبد العزيز يوسف بغدادي عن كاتب استعلامات مركز خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الأساسي للعملاء من خلال الرد على استفساراتهم ومعالجة طلباتهم عبر الهاتف أو الوسائل الإلكترونية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الرد على استفسارات العملاء الأساسية وتقديم المشورة حول منتجات وخدمات وسياسات المنشأة. معالجة طلبات العملاء الأساسية، مثل إرسال الرسائل أو النماذج أو الوثائق الأخرى، بالإضافة إلى معالجة المعاملات المالية. حل شكاوى العملاء البسيطة وإحالة المشكلات الأكثر تعقيدًا إلى الموظف المختص أو مسؤول الشكاوى. تسجيل الاستعلامات والشكاوى الواردة وتوثيق الحلول المتخذة. الالتزام التام بالإجراءات والسياسات المنظمة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو دور مماثل. القدرة على استخدام وسائل الاتصال الهاتفية والإلكترونية بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مركز خدمة العملاء بجدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وتقديم الدعم الفوري لهم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مؤسسة الحديقة والمزرعة عبد العزيز يوسف بغدادي.

263e9906475d2bc7.company_name: مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات
263e9906475d2bc7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وتحديد المواد اللازمة لأعمال الصيانة، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى قياس الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد والأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة حضور فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية عن الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الفنية ومواصفات الصيانة. مهارات جيدة في تحديد العيوب الفنية واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية لإعداد قوائم المواد والأدوات. دقة في قياس الأعمال وحساب الكميات وتدقيقها. مهارات تواصل فعالة مع المهندسين وفرق العمل. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة المباني في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب المتابعة الميدانية لأعمال الصيانة في مختلف الأبنية. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع المهندسين ومحاسبي الكميات وفرق العمل لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

265bf5506eaabc82.job_title: Allocator (Merchandise Planner) The Visitor Head office
265bf5506eaabc82.description: About Chalhoub Group Chalhoub Group has operated as a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East for over seven decades. The Group manages a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and provides distribution and marketing expertise for more than 400 international brands across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. With over 16,000 professionals across eight countries in the Middle East and a presence in LATAM, Chalhoub Group is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and aims to reach Net Zero by 2040. Role Summary Chalhoub Group is seeking an Allocator (Merchandise Planner) to join its team in Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the optimal distribution of inventory and maintaining product availability across retail, e-commerce, and B2B channels. The Allocator will be responsible for inventory planning, replenishment, and monitoring key performance indicators to support efficient supply chain operations. Key Responsibilities Define and execute initial allocation strategies for seasonal products across stores, aligning with assortment and demand plans. Develop and maintain inventory and replenishment plans, considering store space, delivery frequency, and stock requirements. Implement allocation strategies by adapting stock parameters, safety stock, and days of coverage to optimize inventory levels and prevent overstock or stockouts. Manage inventory push initiatives in alignment with sales and clearance strategies, including markdown and promotional activities. Track and initiate inventory balance between stores, MFC (Digital), and the hub to manage In-Stock Availability (ISA) across all networks. Optimize store-to-store stock transfers to balance inventory levels and meet dynamic demand and ISA. Collaborate with retail teams to coordinate upcoming delivery volumes and ensure operational readiness at the store level. Conduct regular store visits with the team. KPI Monitoring Track and analyze planning KPIs, including In-Stock Availability (ISA), Days of Inventory (DOI), and On-Time In-Full (OTIF), to identify and resolve inefficiencies. Track and analyze store-to-store transfers. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Application Process Chalhoub Group is committed to inclusion and diversity, welcoming all applicants regardless of gender, age, race, religion, national origin, or disability status. Candidates are requested to complete assessments and interviews independently, without assistance from generative AI tools, to ensure an accurate evaluation of individual strengths and problem-solving approaches.

265fc22ef6cb3c2f.description: Company overview: Armah Sports Company is transforming the fitness industry in Saudi Arabia by introducing next-generation fitness clubs under two flagship brands: OPTIMO and B_FIT. Driven by our “Smart Club” concept, we provide a seamless, technology-enabled fitness experience that redefines how members engage with health, wellness, and performance. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the cleanliness, organization, and maintenance of the club, including facility repairs. Ensure the club meets health, safety, and legal requirements, including completing regular audits, validating licenses, and enforcing safety procedures. Oversee member-related operational matters, address concerns, and improve processes based on member feedback. Keep operational knowledge and skills up to date to support effective management and quality service. Work collaboratively with the team and assist with other duties as needed. Qualifications & Requirements: · Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in Management, Fitness, or a related field. · At least 4 years of relevant experience, including 1 year in a similar role. · Experience working in an agile environment. Core Competencies: · Time Management Skills · Team Management knowledge · Communication & Relationship Skills · Sound Analytical Thinking · Strong problem-solving skills · Professionalism and Ethics

2685a181e73727d2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى تقييمها وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين ووضع سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية والدعائية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق، وذلك وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير الاستراتيجيات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات وأسعار المنافسين. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المتخصصة في اختبارات السوق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة بوضوح ودقة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة العمل بفعالية ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب متابعة مستمرة لمتغيرات السوق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

26ad565a6d9268e7.description: Expression of Interest: Project Manager Maximus KSA is inviting qualified candidates to express their interest in potential Project Manager opportunities. This Expression of Interest is intended to build a talent pipeline for future operations within Saudi Arabia, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah. About the Role This is an opportunity for experienced Project Managers to be considered for upcoming full-time positions. The role will involve managing projects within Maximus KSA's future operations, contributing to the company's growth and strategic objectives in the region. Candidates should possess a strong background in project management and be prepared to lead initiatives effectively. Key Responsibilities Leading and managing projects from initiation to closure. Developing project plans, including scope, objectives, timelines, and resource allocation. Monitoring project progress, identifying risks, and implementing mitigation strategies. Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Communicating project status and updates to stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in project management. Proven ability to manage complex projects and lead teams. Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools. Excellent organizational and communication skills. Application Process This is an Expression of Interest for potential future opportunities. Applying does not guarantee employment, selection for an interview, or a callback. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps as suitable positions become available.

26cbf46a42ff1915.description: About CosmoDent Clinics CosmoDent Clinics, specializing in Dentistry, Dermatology, and Laser treatments, is located in the Narges District of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The clinic is committed to providing high-quality, effective treatment. We are currently seeking a dedicated Family Dentist or a dentist with Advanced Education in General Dentistry (AEGD) to join our team in a full-time, on-site capacity. The Role of Family Dentist / AEGD This role involves providing comprehensive dental care to patients of all ages. The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of general and preventive dental procedures, working within a modern clinical environment equipped with advanced technology and supported by experienced consultants. The position is based in Riyadh and offers a competitive monthly salary. Key Responsibilities Conducting examinations, diagnosing conditions, and developing comprehensive treatment plans for patients across all age groups. Performing cosmetic fillings, professional cleanings, and various preventive dental treatments. Executing root canal treatments and simple tooth extractions. Referring complex or advanced cases to in-house specialists and consultants as needed. Work Environment and Benefits CosmoDent Clinics offers a supportive and advanced work environment. Dentists benefit from supervision by experienced consultants and have access to modern equipment, including a digital scanner, CT scan, and microscope. The clinic utilizes international-standard materials and maintains a continuous patient flow. Compensation The monthly salary for this full-time position ranges from 9,000 to 25,000 SAR, commensurate with the candidate's qualifications and professional experience.

26ce535d7cb418cc.description: About Tandem Search Tandem Search is an executive search firm based in Dubai, specializing in connecting talent with roles across various markets. The firm is seeking an Intern to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to gain experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, and executive search. About the Internship This internship provides exposure to the full recruitment lifecycle and mentorship from experienced consultants. The role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are based in Riyadh and are Saudi Nationals. 26524f3eeb62a7ba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية، ومتابعة أنشطة الصيانة، وضمان الأداء الدقيق للمعدات بعد الإصلاح. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الصيانة الميكانيكية مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد والمستلزمات اللازمة للصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة تنفيذ أنشطة الصيانة اللازمة وإجراءات إصلاح الأعطال. فحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منتظم. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بأساليب تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير التكاليف والمواد اللازمة لأعمال الصيانة. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور مجموعة من المهارات الفنية والعملية لضمان الأداء الفعال: مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتحليل الفني. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لإدارة برامج الصيانة الوقائية. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم تقارير عمل واضحة ودقيقة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيانة الميكانيكية في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة والاستجابة السريعة للأعطال. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

26f28ef6bdd41c16.description: المسمى الوظيفي: مسؤول/ة مبيعات وخدمة عملاء (قطاع أسنان وجلدية) مقر العمل: الدمام نوع الدوام: دوام كامل ( شفت واحد) سعودي/ة الجنسية الهدف من الوظيفة: تسويق الباقات العلاجية والتجميلية المتاحة في المجمع (أسنان / جلدية). المهام الرئيسية: التواصل الفعّال مع المراجعين عبر الهاتف والواتساب للإجابة على الاستفسارات وتحويلها لمبيعات. شرح وتثقيف المراجعين حول الباقات التجميلية والعلاجية (عروض الأسنان، باقات الجلدية والليزر). متابعة المراجعين بعد الزيارة الأولى لإغلاق وتأكيد مواعيد الخطط العلاجية طويلة المدى (مثل التقويم أو جلسات العلاج). التعامل مع شكاوى أو ملاحظات المراجعين بمرونة ولباقة تامة لضمان ولائهم للمجمع. الشروط والمؤهلات: خبرة سابقة في المبيعات، خدمة العملاء، أو الاستقبال (يفضل في مجمعات طبية أو مراكز تجميل). مهارات تواصل وإقناع استثنائية، وصوت بشوش ولبق عبر الهاتف الإقامة في مدينة الدمام
